findings.problem: The 'old save' goldens were rewritten into rev-2 form (rev 2, levels 0->1, auto nodes added, sp_available 270->40). t_save no longer loads any real rev-1 save end to end, so the migration path the owner cares about has no regression gate in t_save.
findings.fix: Keep the original rev-1 goldens as load inputs (git show claude/mmo-overhaul:...) and compare the loaded result against a separate expected rev-2 file, or add a rev-1 fixture load to t_w2_skills through SaveGame/SaveSanitizer.

findings.problem: A rev-1 save loses its unspent SP: the old golden had 270 SP (student occupation Lv20 payout) and loads with 40. That follows the coordinator's derived-SP decision, but players see it as lost SP.
findings.fix: Put it in the release notes / owner decision log, or grant a one-time migration credit.

findings.problem: A new survivor has 0 SP at character Lv1, so a field kit, which used to be free, cannot be crafted until character Lv2 (100 XP, about 50 gathers or 10 crafts). It is reachable, but the farming tutorial step is blocked at first.
findings.fix: Accept (spec 12 says 1 SP), or make it auto, or make sure the craft card's lock text points the player at earning Lv2.

findings.problem: Leather Strap, Charcoal and Dry Leather need character Lv10 (1800 pioneer XP: about 900 gathers at 2 XP, or 180 crafts). That is probably beyond the first hour. It is not a dead end, because substitutes exist (see verified).
findings.fix: Owner call on pacing; tune xp_for_level or the per-action XP if Lv10 should land within the first session.

findings.problem: As the package report says, the taming pen bonds without checking Data.bonded_cap(), so the spec-09 cap can be bypassed.
findings.fix: W2-BREED: call SkillRules.can_bond / Data.bonded_cap() before bonding.
